title: With Paramount's Acquisition of Warner Bros. on Hold and Netflix Down 38%, Is Netflix Stock Finally a Buy?
title_zh: 派拉蒙对华纳兄弟的收购被搁置，Netflix 股价下跌 38%，Netflix 股票终于值得买入吗？
summary: Video podcasting and gaming could be revenue generators for Netflix, but there isn't anything on the immediate horizon to help reverse stock price losses.
summary_zh: 视频播客和游戏可能会成为 Netflix 的收入来源，但短期内没有任何东西可以帮助扭转股价损失。

title: Louis Navellier sends strong message on Nvidia’s circular deals
title_zh: Louis Navellier 对 Nvidia 的循环交易发出强烈信息
summary: Louis Navellier has been active in the stock market for approximately 46 years, beginning with the publication of his quantitative research in 1980, the MPT Review. He regularly shares his thoughts with TheStreet readers in this column.
summary_zh: 自 1980 年发表定量研究《MPT Review》以来，Louis Navellier 已活跃于股票市场约 46 年。他经常在本专栏中与 TheStreet 读者分享他的想法。

title: Berkshire Hathaway's Record $397 Billion Cash Pile Gives Greg Abel Room for Buybacks or a Big Acquisition
title_zh: 伯克希尔·哈撒韦公司创纪录的 3970 亿美元现金储备为格雷格·阿贝尔提供了回购或大规模收购的空间
summary: The new CEO took over the conglomerate with a massive nest egg that he must try to deploy.
summary_zh: 新任首席执行官接管了这家企业集团，他必须设法利用巨额资金。

title: Salesforce (CRM) Stock May Be 49% Undervalued On Its $1.6B VA Deal
title_zh: Salesforce (CRM) 股票因其 1.6B 美元 VA 交易可能被低估 49%
summary: Salesforce stock has rebounded in recent weeks after a challenging start to the year, and valuation tools now suggest the market price may sit well below an intrinsic value estimate based on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model.
summary_zh: 在经历了今年充满挑战的开局后，Salesforce 股票最近几周出现反弹，估值工具现在表明，市场价格可能远低于基于贴现现金流 (DCF) 模型的内在价值估计。
